p:
Shenzhen Techvision Intelligent Technology Co., Ltd. was founded in 2011 and listed on the Beijing Stock Exchange in 2022. It holds national high-tech enterprise certification and the national "Little Giant" (specialized, refined, unique, and innovative SME) designation, and it has been recognized as the "Guangdong Commercial Intelligent Terminal Engineering Technology Research Center."
Its main business is ODM-based: the company independently develops, designs, manufactures, and sells intelligent terminals, with customers across China, Europe and the Americas, Japan, and Korea. Its core products are consumer electronics and commercial IoT intelligent terminals (terminal devices for xinchuang (IT application innovation), 5G communications, smart retail, network and video conferencing, industrial control, and other fields), used across smart commerce, education, and office environments.
pc: 深圳市慧为智能科技股份有限公司2011年成立，2022年于北交所上市，获国家高新技术企业、国家级专精特新“小巨人”等资质，被认定为“广东省商用智能终端工程技术研究中心”。以ODM模式为主，自主研发、设计、生产、销售智能终端，业务覆盖中国、欧美、日韩等。主营产品涵盖消费电子及商用IoT智能终端（信创、5G通信、智慧零售、网络及视频会议、工业控制等多领域终端设备），应用于智慧商业、教育、办公等多领域。
t: Techvision's product system is built around "core module – motherboard – complete machine – industry solution." The showcase includes the TVI series core modules and motherboards, TVD/TVE series edge computers and cloud terminals, Unisoc 5G products, xinchuang platform products, and customized devices for robotics, vehicle, access control, and ESOP scenarios. The exhibits cover multiple mainstream platforms, including Rockchip, Phytium, HiSilicon, Zhaoxin, Hygon, and MediaTek.
tc: 慧为智能围绕 “核心板-主板-整机-行业解决方案” 的产品体系，带来了包括TVI系列核心板、主板、TVD/TVE系列边缘计算机与云终端、展锐5G、信创平台产品、以及面向机器人、车载、门禁、ESOP等场景的定制化设备，展品覆盖瑞芯微、飞腾、海思、兆芯、海光、MTK等多个主流平台
